visual_logic: Highlights the distinct, spoon-shaped expanding tip lined with fine, needle-like teeth characteristic of Gnathosaurus.
prompt: High-fidelity 3D asset of a Gnathosaurus jaw tip, showcase-focused on its flared 'Spatula Spoon' morphology, rendered in a 3D animated feature film aesthetic with soft, stylized, and slightly rounded edges. The long, slender jaw expands at the terminal end into a flat, circular, paddle-like spoon tip, which is densely packed with fine, outward-pointing, needle-like ivory teeth that splay outwards sideways. The texture is an appealing soft ivory and cream buff color showcasing high-quality tactile finishes. The specimen is oriented vertically and perfectly centered in a 1:1 square composition, carefully scaled to occupy the central power-zone, ensuring a strict 25% negative space safety margin on all four sides. Placed flat against a neutral, 50% grey studio floor plane with high-contrast contact shadows. Illuminated by soft studio lighting with ambient occlusion to accentuate the unusual widened spatula geometry and fine splayed tooth lines.
